c74object.name: evi_plateverb
c74object.digest: evieve Gen Object. Plate reverb based on yafr2~ with additional filtering and smoothing
c74object.description:
evi_plateverb is an abstraction for using inside gen~ or GenExpr.
evi_plateverb.gendsp requires the GenExpr file(s):
evi_reverb_library.genexpr
Based on yafr2~ from MSP ('Plate reverb in the style of Griesinger' by Randy Jones). This version for evieve with dry/wet and eq added, as well as modifications for better filtering, interpolation and smoothing, and zero hold delay changes. Parameters normalised 0..1. Clickless and smooth changes possible for all parameters. In gen~ alone (as opposed to the MSP abstraction evi.plateverb~) this is tricky to use as the damping coefficients are produced externally via the 'evi_damp_coeffs.gendsp' abstraction. See 'evi_rcfilters.genexpr' for coefficients calculations alternatives.

geninlet.name: in
geninlet.digest: Mono / In Left / In 1. Audio input mono / left / 1, depending on @stereo attribute.

geninlet.name: nothing
geninlet.digest: / In Right / In 2. Audio input nothing / right / 2, depending on @stereo attribute.

attribute.name: apGain1
attribute.description: false

attribute.name: apGain2
attribute.description: false

attribute.name: apGain3
attribute.description: false

attribute.name: apGain4
attribute.description: false

attribute.name: bypass
attribute.description: Flag 0/1, smooth bypass the reverb (1). Bypassing also CPU-mutes the internal DSP.

attribute.name: decay
attribute.description: Normalised 0..1, one of the original parameters. Length of reverb late reflections decay. Higher values give a longer decay.

attribute.name: delayTime1
attribute.description: In samples: floor(samplerate * 0.26636 + 0.5) + 1

attribute.name: delayTime2
attribute.description: In samples: floor(samplerate * 0.25995 + 0.5) + 1

attribute.name: diffuse
attribute.description: Normalised 0..1, one of the original parameters. Amount of diffuseness in the reflections. Effects times of multiple embedded delay lines.

attribute.name: dry
attribute.description: In dB -90..0, there is no 'dry/wet' in this reverb. Instead we have separate dry and wet gains. This dry gain controls the amount of gain applied to the unprocessed audio in the final mix.

attribute.name: highshelfG
attribute.description: Pre warped damping highshelf frequency coefficient normalised 0..1, see 'evi_rcfilters.genexpr' for coefficients calculators.

attribute.name: highshelfK
attribute.description: Pre warped damping highshelf gain coefficient -3..1, see 'evi_rcfilters.genexpr' for coefficients calculators.

attribute.name: lowshelfG
attribute.description: Pre warped damping lowshelf frequency coefficient normalised 0..1, see 'evi_rcfilters.genexpr' for coefficients calculators.

attribute.name: lowshelfK
attribute.description: Pre warped damping lowshelf gain coefficient -3..1, see 'evi_rcfilters.genexpr' for coefficients calculators.

attribute.name: pan
attribute.description: Normalised 0..1, input panning if 'stereo' attribute == 0 (mono). 0.5=center.

attribute.name: size
attribute.description: Normalised 0..1, one of the original parameters. The perceived size of the reverb.

attribute.name: smoothtime
attribute.description: Set the smoothing time in ms of all the internal parameter smoothing functions.

attribute.name: stereo
attribute.description: Select 0, 1, 2. No smoothing. This affects the audio inputs of the reverb (output is always stereo), notably the internal summing of the two inputs. 0=mono in (with pan control), 1=stereo in, 2=two separate channels in.

attribute.name: sumMul
attribute.description: false

attribute.name: sumMul05
attribute.description: false

attribute.name: sumMulSq
attribute.description: false

attribute.name: sumMulinv
attribute.description: false

attribute.name: wet
attribute.description: In dB -90..0, there is no 'dry/wet' in this reverb. Instead we have separate dry and wet gains. This wet gain controls the amount of gain applied to the processed reverberation (late reflections) in the final mix.
